view.scene_description: A wide-angle view inside a large warehouse with tall blue metal racks filled with stacked white and blue crates. The floor is concrete, and fluorescent lights illuminate the space from above. A person in a high-visibility vest is visible in the distance near pallets. The foreground shows blurred motion, suggesting movement during capture.

objects.label: blue metal rack
objects.observation: Tall blue metal rack on the left side of the frame, partially blurred due to motion. It holds multiple rows of white and blue crates. The rack's vertical beams have holes for adjustable shelving. It stands on the concrete floor and appears to be freestanding.

objects.label: white crate
objects.observation: White rectangular crates stacked in rows on the blue rack. They appear uniform in size and shape. Some are partially obscured by other crates or the rack structure. They rest directly on the rack shelves.

objects.label: person in high-visibility vest
objects.observation: A person wearing a bright yellow-green high-visibility vest is standing in the background near pallets. Their face and specific features are indistinct due to distance and image quality. They appear to be working or inspecting items.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth gray concrete floor covering the entire ground area. It has some scattered debris and faint marks. The floor extends into the distance between the racks and under the overhead lighting.

objects.label: fluorescent light fixture
objects.observation: Overhead fluorescent light fixtures mounted on the ceiling. They emit bright white light, illuminating the warehouse. The fixtures are suspended from the ceiling structure and appear to be part of the building’s permanent installation.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s2-34451", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
